import re

rendezvous_re = re.compile(r'^(https?://)?(www\.)?([a-zA-Z0-9]+)(\.[a-zA-Z0-9-]+)\.?([^/]*)$')

rendezvous = input("Where would you like to meet? ")
if rendezvous_re.match(rendezvous):
    print("Getting directions...")
else:
    print(f"Invalid adres, sorry I can't help you with {rendezvous}")
